title: BRIGHTON JUMP ABOVE MAN CITY AFTER BRENTFORD'S 8-MINUTE COLLAPSE
description:
From one down to ten men in eight minutes. Brentford's night went wrong very fast.

Diego Gomez opened the scoring from long range in the fifteenth minute. Eight minutes later, Igor Thiago was sent off after a VAR review. Pascal Gross added a penalty before half-time. Eleven against ten, and calm as ever. Brighton won two-nil.

That puts them second, five points behind Arsenal and above Manchester City. Keith Andrews criticised the officials, and it was Brentford's second league game this season to end with ten men.
